keyword: tcu horned frogs men's basketball vs ohio state buckeyes men's basketball timeline
claims: No. 9 seed TCU Horned Frogs defeated No. 8 seed Ohio State Buckeyes 66-64 in 2026 NCAA Tournament First Round matchup on March 19, 2026.
Matchup location was Bon Secours Wellness Arena, Greenville, South Carolina.
TCU Horned Frogs led by 15 points at halftime.
Halftime score was TCU 29, Ohio State 24.
Final score was TCU 66, Ohio State 64.
Bruce Thornton scored early for Ohio State Buckeyes.
TCU Horned Frogs took control with a 23-15 lead.
23-15 lead was aided by multiple 3-pointers from Micah Robinson and Xavier Edmonds.
Ohio State Buckeyes overcame a 15-point deficit in the second half.
Ohio State Buckeyes took a 55-50 lead with 6:19 left, according to USA Today.
TCU Horned Frogs held off the rally, winning 66-64 to advance, as detailed by Yahoo Sports.
Micah Robinson of TCU scored 18 points.
John Mobley Jr. of Ohio State Buckeyes scored 15 points.
TCU Horned Frogs advances to face the winner of No. 1 Duke/No. 16 Siena in the Second Round on Saturday, March 21.
